changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document".template_application( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, user_id UUID, company_id UUID, name TEXT, comment TEXT, file_url TEXT, contract_type TEXT, price DOUBLE PRECISION, status TEXT, paid_status BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
